clue.text: Minor reprimand as result of make-up misapplication?

definitions.meaning: a light telling-off or token punishment
slap is slang for cosmetics, so make-up daubed on the arm in the wrong place

explanation.surface: A mild scolding, it seems, follows a botched job with cosmetics.
explanation.walkthrough: SLAP is British theatrical slang for make-up; read literally, the phrase is greasepaint put on the arm rather than the face.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a token punishment far milder than the offence might merit.

clue.text: Bird box with commotion beneath

indicators.note: in a down entry the commotion goes below the box

parts.note: to spar is to box
a row is a noisy disturbance

explanation.surface: A bird box sits above a noisy scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' looks like a nest box but is the verb spar.
explanation.definitionFit: A small brown songbird familiar in gardens; an example of a bird.

clue.text: Meat in seafood he cooked is extremely radical

indicators.note: cooked food has been prepared and altered, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A chef sneaks meat into seafood, which is a daring culinary step.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges all of MEAT IN SEAFOOD HE; 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideas too advanced or innovative for their era are thought radical in the extreme.

clue.text: Aware of filling used in oriental dumpling

indicators.note: the filling of the dumpling word is its inside, the outer letters dropped

parts.note: a wonton is a Chinese dumpling

explanation.surface: Someone knows what stuffing goes into a Chinese dumpling.
explanation.walkthrough: The filling of WONTON is its contents without the outer W and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Being 'on to' someone means having found out what they are doing, so knowing about it.

clue.text: Tango casually, holding daughter, being a bit squiffy

parts.note: T is Tango in the NATO alphabet

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the daughter goes inside

parts.note: idly means in a casual, unhurried way

explanation.surface: A tipsy dancer does a lazy tango with their daughter in their arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Squiffy and tiddly are both British slang for slightly drunk.

clue.text: Guided from base and cut around back of fort

parts.note: e is the base of natural logarithms

indicators.note: the cut goes around the final letter of fort

parts.note: to score is to cut a line into

indicators.note: the back of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Troops were led out of base and slashed round the rear of a fort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts T, the last letter of 'fort', inside SCORED.
explanation.definitionFit: To escort someone is to accompany and lead them, so the past tense matches guided.

clue.text: Ringing plastic surgeon about dad's rear and hip

indicators.note: the rearranged surgeon goes about the other pieces
plastic means mouldable, so the letters of surgeon are reshaped
the rear of a word is its last letter

parts.note: hip and in both mean fashionable

explanation.walkthrough: 'plastic' yields RESOUNG; 'about' wraps it round D, the final letter of 'dad'.

clue.text: Appreciative response from resistance with independent government dividing country

parts.note: to make a stand is to resist

indicators.note: dividing splits something apart, so the government goes inside the country

parts.note: a nation is a country
gov is short for government

explanation.walkthrough: 'dividing' splits the country after its first letter; 'from' and 'with' are links.

clue.text: Chance upon fish shop

indicators.note: in a down entry the chance piece sits on top of the fish

explanation.surface: Someone happens across a fishmonger's.

explanation.definitionFit: To shop someone is slang for informing on them to the authorities, i.e. to inform on.

clue.text: Warned treadle is unreliable

indicators.note: something unreliable cannot be counted on to stay as it is, so the letters of treadle get rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone was cautioned that a foot pedal on a machine might fail.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean having been given notice of danger; a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Flood when scoundrel punctures canoe on vacation

indicators.note: puncturing pierces something, so these pieces go into the middle of the emptied canoe
a word vacated has its insides emptied out, leaving just the first and last letters of canoe

a cad is an old word for a dishonourable man

explanation.surface: A rogue holes a canoe while its owners are away on holiday, letting the water in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on vacation' means emptied, leaving only the outer letters of canoe; 'punctures' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A cascade is a rush of water pouring down, so it works as a synonym for a flood or torrent.

clue.text: Once more, make love after wine

indicators.note: the piece for love is placed after the piece for wine

parts.note: red is short for red wine
love is nil in tennis, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: A romantic invitation to go again after a glass of wine.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the verb phrase 'Once more, make', i.e. make again.
explanation.definitionFit: To do something over is to perform or make it a second time, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Everything improved at centre managed by multi-talented person

parts.note: all means everything

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle letters, here the middle two of improved

parts.note: under means managed by, as in 'under new management'

explanation.surface: A versatile employee whose all-round improvement came under good management.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at centre' takes RO, the middle two letters of 'improved'.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket and generally, this is someone skilled in many areas, such as both batting and bowling.

clue.text: Dodgy woman in German university fencing diamonds fast

indicators.note: fencing encloses, so the woman and university pieces close round the diamonds

D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games
Lent is the Christian period of fasting

explanation.walkthrough: 'fencing' suggests handling stolen goods but here means enclosing D between FRAU and U.
explanation.definitionFit: Dodgy is informal for dishonest or deceitful, matching a synonym for crooked.

clue.text: Was eating female monarch's biscuits

indicators.note: eating takes something inside, so the word was surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: Someone was munching the queen's biscuits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eating' signals the insertion; 'Was' is used as a word, not as the verb of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin crisp sweet biscuits, often served with ice cream, are one kind of biscuit.

clue.text: Contend encyclopedia contains bias

indicators.note: the two words hold the answer within them, running across the word break

explanation.surface: Someone argues that an encyclopedia is slanted.
explanation.definitionFit: An inclination or leaning in one direction is a bias; a synonym.

clue.text: He painted male garbed at first in orderly attire

indicators.note: the first letter of garbed goes inside the rearranged attire
put in order, so the letters of attire are arranged anew
at first takes the opening letter of garbed

clue.text: Country men with guns surrounded by barking hounds

barking means mad in British slang, so the letters of hounds are scrambled

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunners

explanation.definitionFit: Honduras is a Central American nation, an example of a country.

clue.text: Check what might be required for picnic?

definitions.text: what might be required for picnic?
definitions.meaning: a wicker basket packed with food for an outdoor meal

explanation.surface: Checking what you need to take on a picnic.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a verb meaning hinder; the other is a lidded basket for carrying food outdoors.

clue.text: Article in Paris South, antique still on the market

parts.note: un is the French indefinite article
antique means old

explanation.surface: A piece in southern Paris, an antique, has yet to find a buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods still on the market have not yet found a buyer.

clue.text: Prepared to take away silver in horse competition on day

indicators.note: in a down entry the first piece sits on the day
taking away removes the silver from the horse competition

parts.note: dressage is an equestrian event of trained movements
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A rider got ready to win a silver medal at a dressage event on the day.

clue.text: Cut short promotion on book hastily, perhaps

indicators.note: a word cut short loses its last letter

parts.note: an advert promotes a product

explanation.surface: A promotion for a book was hastily cut back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hastily, perhaps' defines by example; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Hastily is an example of a word that modifies a verb, a part-of-speech label.

clue.text: Spy boss expressed hesitation infiltrating a military group by Eastern Front

parts.note: M is the head of MI6 in the James Bond stories

indicators.note: to infiltrate is to get inside, so the hesitation goes into the military group

parts.note: a squad is a small unit of soldiers
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.walkthrough: 'Front' looks like part of 'Eastern Front' but is the definition; 'infiltrating' signals the insertion.

clue.text: Surge of water with hail

definitions.meaning: a swell rolling along the sea's surface

explanation.surface: A rush of seawater arrives together with a hailstorm.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a moving ridge on the sea; the other is a greeting gesture of the hand.

clue.text: Claim place on middle of seat

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names

indicators.note: middle of takes the central letters of seat

explanation.surface: Someone stakes their right to a spot in the middle of a seat.

clue.text: Obvious identification is required in organised activity

parts.note: an event is an organised occasion

explanation.surface: Entry to an organised event demands showing ID.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain to see and clear to everyone; a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Celebrity, initially learner, in English broadcasts making cakes

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of celebrity

parts.note: L is the learner plate on a British car
to air a programme is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: A celebrity chef, once a beginner, presents baking shows on English television.
explanation.definitionFit: Choux-pastry fingers filled with cream and topped with chocolate are a kind of cake.

clue.text: Silly act, that man ran off with bride

parts.note: a feat is a deed or act
he refers to that man

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so ran and bride are jumbled

explanation.surface: A foolish deed: the groom bolted with someone's bride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges RAN and BRIDE to RBRAINED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone scatterbrained and lacking sense is described as silly; a synonym.
